name: Sandro
description: A mobile robotic manipulator for plastic waste collection from beaches.

name: Robovolc
description: RoboVolc is an advanced robotic platform specifically engineered for autonomous exploration in high-risk volcanic environments. Designed to withstand the harsh conditions of Mount Etna.

name: Arnold
description: ARNOLD is an autonomous robotic platform designed for the automated disinfection of indoor surfaces and objects, minimizing the spread of pathogens such as COVID-19.

name: U-Go
description: A high-traction tracked rover for autonomous off-road navigation, designed for SLAM and path-planning development in unstructured environments.

name: TetheRobot
description: Multi-robot system composed of a ground vehicle and a multi-copter connected each other with a tether.

name: DJI S900
description: A high-payload endurance drone equipped with RTK and advanced imaging, specifically designed for international drone competitions and multi-robot coordination tasks.

name: DJI F550
description: Drone equipped with RTK and cameras for multi-robot coordination.
